# Partial partitions (US 7,799,980 B1) on the Spencer body model (generated by partition_check.py)

Body model of the Spencer report §7.3: 45 mm thick, about 70 cm³ of air, the thumb-face half solid in the tail. Two partitions at 0.18–0.21 and 0.42–0.44 of the body length from the bulb end, rising from the thumb face. Thumb holes 12 mm, at 0.11 and 0.54. Grid 1.25 mm.

*Blocked* is the share of the chamber's cross-section the larger partition closes. *Conductance left* is (f / f0)² × (V / V0) against the chamber without partitions: what remains of the open holes' effect on the pitch. The open-hole frequencies leave out the window and the outer end correction; they only serve the comparison.
